name: tqdm-claude
description: Claude Code mod: live tqdm-style progress bars above the prompt for background tasks and subagents, with crash and stall detection.

charset.title: Progress glyphs
charset.description: auto picks unicode, or ascii where the locale names a charset that is not UTF-8. unicode: eighth-cell bars and a braille spinner. blocks: full and shaded cells only (code page 437), for a font that lacks the others. ascii: # and - like tqdm's ascii mode.

footer.title: Summary in the footer
footer.description: Also sums up running and failed tasks at the end of the hint line under the prompt, beside Claude Code's own task pills.

agents.title: Follow subagents
agents.description: Also shows subagents (the tasks list's agent rows) with their elapsed time and how they ended.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: A native notification (your notification channel) when a task ends. failures: a failure or an early end. always: also a stop, and a success that took a minute or more. off: none.

stuck.title: Stuck-turn warning
stuck.description: Warns in the band when a turn has had no tool call start or end for 3 minutes: Claude may be stuck.
